description:
The saved keywords and their topics, best Opportunity first. Free.
view:
- keywords(limit?, noTopic?, topic?, page?, months?): Each saved keyword with its numbers (competition, bids, other intents, what Google shows, the top 10's strength, the 12-month trend), Search Console position, topic and page (none, planned, writing, ready, failed, published) with its live URL. Filter by topic id, page or noTopic.
- topics(limit?, page?): Topics: the saved keywords Google answers with the same pages, one page each. page none = a page to make.
name: get_keywords
title: Get keywords
